title: Chapter 1874: Made By Your Subject (II)
content:
Chapter 1874: Made By Your Subject (II)

Seeing the emotion in Li Ximing's expression, Yan Dushui shook his head. "To see the world's great seas and famous rivers before I die is a fine thing."

They exchanged pleasantries for a while before guilt flashed across his face. "I promised to fight on your behalf, fellow Daoist. Who could have known my body would fail so quickly? I am of little use now, but I will do what I can!"

Li Ximing sighed. "Your body is unwell, senior. Fighting would consume your remaining life many times faster. How could I turn a blind eye to that? Say no more of it!"

Yan Dushui was touched, but also more bewildered. "But now that I have come all this way..."

Li Ximing shook his head gravely and asked, "You mentioned long ago that our families share ancient ties of kinship. Would you tell me what arrangements you have made? Which disciple is cultivating in Nine Mounds... If I meet them in the future, I could offer some care."

Yan Dushui had hardly traveled so far merely to admire the scenery. He had come both to repay a favor and to make arrangements for after his death. Li Ximing's words spoke to both concerns, bringing tears to the old man's eyes.

"Zhaojing... You are truly noble... If only I had known you sooner... Now I have nothing left with which to repay you..."

When Li Ximing waved this aside, he continued, "My disciple is called Yan Chuan. He studies under Cao Tingwen of Nine Mounds's Zhiyan Peak. Nine Mounds will provide him with spirit items. If he fails to break through, they will seek another talented disciple from my lineage. Everything I have accumulated in my lifetime is deposited with Nine Mounds..."

Li Ximing nodded and asked, "If he attains divine ability, will he be counted as a disciple of Nine Mounds?"

Yan Dushui fell silent for a moment, then replied tearfully, "He should be... But under the immortal mountain's rules, once he enters Nine Mounds, he can no longer look after his clansmen below. There are several hundred thousand of them out at sea. Though their lives should be safe... he will likely have no say over their future prospects!"

After all, those people were also under Nine Mounds's protection, so they would hardly be carried off and eaten by demonic creatures. But how Yan Chuan would regard his clan in the future was difficult to say.

Li Ximing paused as though considering the matter. "I do have an idea."

Yan Dushui looked up hopefully as Li Ximing said, "Why not secure another refuge for your clan? I hear there is a Daoist Master Xiehu in [Sandalwood Plain Desert]. He is upright, powerful, and places great importance on his promises. He would be particularly suitable."

Yan Dushui had already made other arrangements, placing descendants elsewhere as well. He had thought Mount Qusi might be willing to accept a member of the Yan Family, only for Li Ximing to mention someone entirely unrelated. Yet the suggestion tempted him.

The distant Western Sea would be even better... With a Daoist Master like that as their patron, bringing a few descendants here would give them a good refuge.

He sighed. "I am utterly penniless now. The one portion of Valley Water I have left must go to my juniors. All I have to offer is this failing body..."

To prolong his life for these last few years, Yan Dushui had used up nearly all the assorted spirit materials in his possession. Li Ximing, however, said seriously, "I know a Daoist Master Daomian who has close ties with Xiehu. You can visit him with Daomian's introduction."

He smiled and said, "Do you remember the place where that [Banished Essence] spirit item was kept?"

Understanding dawned on Yan Dushui, and he murmured thoughtfully, "Well..."

Li Ximing smiled. "That grotto heaven is preserved by [Banished Essence]. Without your family's secret technique, no one can find it. Even those you lead there forget the way as soon as they turn away... It contains not only various forms of Yin Qi, but also all manner of ancient shamanic inscriptions from the Underworld's judiciary!

"Daoist Master Xiehu cultivates [Supreme Shaman], so his lineage is firmly tied to the Underworld's judiciary. He also aspires to attain the Dao. How could he remain unmoved if you told him about this? Whether it proves useful or not, he will certainly want to take a look. If it truly helps him greatly, the debt of gratitude for helping him attain the Dao would weigh as heavily as Mount Tai. What would taking a disciple amount to? Even if you asked him to kill someone for you... it would hardly be out of the question!"

Yan Dushui stared blankly, remaining silent for a long while before murmuring, "True... I am a dying man, so I don't need to fear him forcing the secret technique out of me... The Yan Family is also under Nine Mounds's protection. Whatever methods he might employ, they don't need to fear him...

"And there is so little left of that incense stick in the cave dwelling. Once it burns out, even knowing the secret technique will not let him find the place. There would be nothing to gain by betraying my kindness..."

Li Ximing smiled. "You needn't worry about that. During my few months here, I have heard of Daoist Master Xiehu's reputation. He once opened a secret realm together with others and proved true to his word in every respect. A fellow Daoist who accompanied him died inside, yet to honor a single promise, he traveled hundreds of kilometers to deliver even [Heavenly Origin Essence] to that man's descendants.

"I later met him myself and refined a pill for him. He even asked me in great detail about Mount Wu!"

Yan Dushui put little faith in such stories, but his eyes gradually brightened as Li Ximing continued with an inscrutable smile. "You could invite him back to the Eastern Sea, let him look around at his leisure, and choose whichever junior most appeals to him as a disciple..."

"Exactly!" Visibly tempted, Yan Dushui exclaimed, "Thank you for your guidance, fellow Daoist!"

Yet after thanking him, Yan Dushui began to reconsider. He hardly believed there was any genuine affection between their families. Li Ximing must want something in return for this unprompted assistance. That mention of 'killing someone' stirred a thought within him.

What do I have that he could want? It can only be a favor from Daoist Master Xiehu.

Yan Dushui said, "I must repay you for being so considerate! But as for killing anyone... I am old and do not wish to leave my descendants more enemies. If a disciple of my family enters his tutelage, and Daoist Master Xiehu gains something from his journey east yet still owes me a favor, I will certainly ask him to repay your kindness!"

Li Ximing waved a hand and smiled. "You are too kind, fellow Daoist. If we truly gain a favor from Daoist Master Xiehu and the Li Family grows close to him, how could we fail to show your descendants special consideration?"

If Xiehu truly valued affection and loyalty, his disciples would hardly need to call in a favor to receive his care. It would be better to trade that favor to the Li Family.

Having reached an unspoken agreement, Yan Dushui immediately made this his highest priority and asked solemnly, "Shall I visit him now?"

Li Ximing smiled faintly. This really was something only Li Ximing could have arranged. Only he and Yan Dushui had entered that place together and knew what it contained. And as someone from the Supreme Yang Dao lineage who had formed ties with both Great Xiukui Temple and imperial descendants of the Underworld's judiciary, he understood better than anyone how precious that cave dwelling was!

No one but Yan Dushui can find that place. But with the Immortal Mirror, once I've been there and know roughly where it lies, I can find it again... Once Quewan breaks through, there would be no harm in letting her take a look.

He turned his cup in his hand.

Yan Dushui has no profound incense, so he can only enter one last time. But my family has some...

For some reason, the terrifying sight at [Middle Broadjade Mountain] returned to Li Ximing's mind. Once bitten by a snake, one fears even a well rope for ten years. Thus, he could not help hesitating.

Some things in this world are better left unknown... As for that place, I should obtain the secret technique from Yan Dushui, and have a proper explanation for returning. Besides, once the profound incense burns out, the cave dwelling will dissipate. I cannot let him use up the last wisp. Only then will I have a chance to replenish it later.

He took a sip of tea and smiled. "If this works out, I hope you will leave enough to preserve the cave dwelling rather than let it dissipate. A junior in my family practices shamanic arts. If she reaches the Purple Mansion Realm, I would like her to have a chance to look inside."

Yan Dushui's eyes lit up, and he nodded delightedly. "You mean Quewan, surely? She is in seclusion at Nine Mounds. I've heard the elders speak of her. A true genius! What a fortunate connection; what a fortunate connection. I will remember."

Seeing how eager he was to forge more ties, Li Ximing chuckled. He sought out Daomian and sent the two on their way, then quietly returned to the courtyard. Refilling his cup with tea, he smiled to himself.

There is no need to confront him directly or spend a fortune persuading him. If everything goes as planned, he will end up owing me a favor instead!
